scoring: sum 1/(60 + source rank), ranks start at 1, absent products contribute zero; exact rational accumulation/order, serialized binary64 score; ascending product_id for equal rational scores
comparison: same incomplete-judgment metrics; paired RRF-minus-reference intervals against BM25 and dense on identical locale-normalized query groups; query-weighted overall/per locale plus equal-locale means
cohort: exactly 78 original bm25-error-analysis-v1 cases with zero_kind=no_title_token_overlap; this describes judged-candidate titles, not the entire catalog
recovery: report known-Exact additions/losses relative to BM25, net query recall wins/regressions, and BM25-zero-known-Exact to RRF-positive queries; no lexical-overlap or nonzero-score rescue claim
union_diagnostic: known-Exact coverage in source top-100 union, up to 200 products; candidate opportunity upper bound, not Recall@100 of a served ranking
decision: nominate RRF as the next offline development reference only if overall recall paired lower CI >0 against both sources and no locale mean recall regresses versus BM25; otherwise retain BM25. This is not a test-set release or serving adoption
hypothesis: complementary lexical and dense candidates may help; no gain is assumed, no weight/constant/depth sweep
repeat: two fresh fusion runs must reproduce ranked results, per-query/cohort/union diagnostics, all metrics/intervals and decision; preserve original source artifacts
scope: offline fusion only; no re-encoding, new retrieval, ANN, tuning, training, API, LLM judgment or official test access
